privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: How we process your data in PartyPass

sections.title: 1. Data controller
paragraphs: The controller of personal data processed in the PartyPass Service is the platform operator. Contact: kontakt@partypass.pl.

sections.title: 2. What data we collect
paragraphs: We process account data (name, email), events and guest data entered by the user, and technical data (logs, session identifiers) necessary to operate the service.
Guest data (e.g. name, email, RSVP response) is processed solely to provide invitation and event management features.

sections.title: 3. Purposes and legal bases
paragraphs: We process data to provide the service (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR), handle payments (lit. b), ensure security (lit. f), and — where consent is given — for marketing purposes (lit. a).

sections.title: 4. Data recipients
paragraphs: We use infrastructure providers (e.g. Firebase/Google Cloud, EmailJS) acting as processors under data processing agreements.
Data is not sold to third parties for marketing purposes.

sections.title: 5. Retention period
paragraphs: Account data is kept for as long as you use the Service and until the account is deleted, unless a longer period is required by law.
After account deletion, data is permanently removed from active systems within a reasonable technical timeframe.

sections.title: 6. Your rights
paragraphs: You have the right of access, rectification, erasure, restriction of processing, data portability, and to object — within the limits set by the GDPR.
You may lodge a complaint with your supervisory authority. In Poland: the President of the Personal Data Protection Office (PUODO).

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.subtitle: Terms of use for the PartyPass platform

sections.title: 1. General provisions
paragraphs: These terms define the rules for using the PartyPass service (the "Service") provided by the platform operator.
Using the Service means you accept these terms. If you do not accept them, do not use the Service.

sections.title: 2. User account
paragraphs: Registration requires accurate data and keeping your password confidential. You are responsible for actions performed on your account.
The operator may suspend or delete an account in case of a breach of these terms, the law, or the security of other users.

sections.title: 3. Plans and payments
paragraphs: The Service offers Starter (free), Pro, and Enterprise plans with different feature limits described on the pricing page.
Fees for paid plans are charged according to the selected billing cycle. Payment details are provided at checkout.

sections.title: 4. Permitted use
paragraphs: You may not use the Service to send spam, infringe third-party rights, or circumvent platform technical limits.
You retain rights to content you submit (e.g. guest data) and grant the operator a license necessary to provide the Service.

sections.title: 5. Liability
paragraphs: The Service is provided "as is". The operator strives to ensure continuity but does not guarantee uninterrupted access.
To the extent permitted by law, the operator's liability is limited to fees paid by the user in the last 12 months.

sections.title: 6. Contact
paragraphs: For matters related to these terms, contact: kontakt@partypass.pl.

sections.title: 1. Information for event guests
paragraphs: The event organizer (PartyPass user) is the controller of guest data entered into the system. PartyPass acts as a processor under a data processing agreement with the organizer.

sections.title: 2. Scope of processing
paragraphs: Under the processing agreement we handle guest identification and contact data, RSVP status, dietary preferences, and notes entered by the organizer — solely to deliver the event.

sections.title: 3. Security measures
paragraphs: We use transmission encryption (HTTPS), Firebase authentication-based access control, and database security rules that limit access to the account owner's data.

sections.title: 4. Sub-processors
paragraphs: Data may be processed by Google Firebase (hosting, database, authentication) and — when configured — EmailJS (email delivery). The sub-processor list is updated in the privacy policy.

sections.title: 5. GDPR contact
paragraphs: Organizers: kontakt@partypass.pl. Event guests should direct requests regarding their data to the event organizer who entered it into the system.
